steps: Observe POST /api/upload/multiple → 404 NOT_FOUND while POST /api/upload → 401 (route exists).

Browser: sign in as the seeded user, open /products/create, attach two images → POST /api/upload/multiple 404 and the form shows 'Upload failed. Try again.' (node scripts/browser/product-photo-upload.cjs <dir with two PNGs> <screenshot path>).
title: Product photos cannot be uploaded: frontend calls a missing /api/upload/multiple route
expected: Adding photos on /products/create uploads each selected image and shows previews.
actual: ProductCreate renders <ImageUpload multiple max={6}>, which always calls uploadFiles() → POST /api/upload/multiple. The backend only registers POST /api/upload (single file). Every product-photo upload fails with 'Upload failed. Try again.'
impact: Sellers cannot attach photos when creating or editing a product — a core seller journey. Products go live without images or sellers abandon the flow. Confirmed in the browser on 2026-11-05.
fix: Either add POST /api/upload/multiple (upload.array('files', 10), same signature validation as the single route, returns { files: [{ url }] }), or change uploadFiles() to call POST /api/upload once per file with bounded concurrency. Add a Vitest test for uploadFiles and a Playwright step that uploads two photos on /products/create.
regression_test: Contract test: every literal /api path in frontend source resolves to a registered backend route (scripts/inventory-frontend.mjs in CI).
